must_misses.title: Disallow Negative Amount / Non-Zero Transfer Guard
must_misses.observed_candidate: REQ-DJ-003: Account Balance Floor Enforcement and Overdraft Prevention
must_misses.forensic_cause: The model synthesized a post-state balance invariant (preventing balance < floor / overdraft), but omitted the pre-state transfer input validation predicate (transfer amount > 0 and non-negative). Coverage audit focused on account solvency rather than input quantity validation.
must_misses.fix_path: Enhance Stage 2 Pass 2 coverage audit prompt with explicit invariant duality check (pre-condition input guards vs post-condition state bounds).

must_misses.title: Export Patient Diagnostic Records to Analytics
must_misses.observed_candidate: REQ-001: Strip 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor Direct Identifiers & REQ-003: Analytics Ingestion Format Standard (UNKNOWN)
must_misses.forensic_cause: The prompt requested: 'Mask PHI data... before exporting to downstream analytics ingestion'. The model treated 'exporting' purely as background pipeline context and focused 100% of its explicit requirements on masking transformations and unstated format schemas, omitting the standalone export/dispatch action as an explicit requirement.
must_misses.fix_path: Ensure Stage 1 verb-action decomposition explicitly registers egress/export directives as primary functional requirements alongside transformation invariants.

must_misses.title: Cryptographic Credential Hashing (Argon2id / bcrypt)
must_misses.observed_candidate: REQ-BOUNDARY-001: Unstated Identity Provider Integration Boundary (UNKNOWN)
must_misses.forensic_cause: The ambiguous prompt ('We need an authentication platform with token revocation') led the model to reason that user authentication could be delegated to an external IdP (surfaced in Pass 3 as UNKNOWN). Consequently, it did not derive local password cryptographic hashing (Argon2id/bcrypt) because it refused to assume internal credential storage.
must_misses.fix_path: Structure Stage 2 Pass 2 gap analysis to evaluate conditional invariant trees: 'IF local credential store THEN enforce Argon2id hashing; ELSE IF external IdP THEN enforce OIDC/SAML token validation'.
